v3.4.1: Code Canonicality is the first section in every mode, mechanically checked. (The repair-plan-gate half was DISCARDED after verification: 0 of 2 target expectations flipped and two previously-passing ones regressed; see eng-init-evolution-r3/FINAL_REPORT.md.) Code review found the docstring's compensating control was never wired: the Stage 5 command passed only Verification Matrix, so an AGENTS.md with no Code Canonicality section went green. The flag is now in the documented command and both halves are pinned.

v3.4.1 review: check_agents/check_root_backups were nested under --require-ci-aggregator, so every AGENTS.md check silently no-opped without that flag; absence of an optional section is not failed where an explicit flag already demands presence The source-shape regexes were removed: a single blank line broke them while the code was still correct, and the invariant is proven behaviourally by the tests pinned below.

2026-08-10 first-principles audit: the two readiness validators were named in the reference index, had zero tests and were never executed (L0); three checks had a real mechanism and zero proof of rejection (L2 mistaken for L3). All five now carry dual assertions and the validators are wired into selfcheck.

2026-08-10 test verification: selfcheck discards bytecode caches; mutation_sweep.py neuters every failable branch and proves a test goes red. Swept 100 branches: 0 survive now; the initial count is unknown and at least 45 (that sweep's log was captured through `tail -45`, see postmortem 0002 instance 5). mutation_check.py was deleted as superseded: it carried the replace(...,1) defect that produced a false HOLE, and shipping two overlapping mutation tools is the parallel-implementation pattern this skill forbids. The sweep restores on SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP and refuses to report while a mutation is still on disk: a killed run had left `pass  # MUTATED` in a committed checker, because `finally` does not survive a signal.

eng-init installs an incident pipeline for others (Q6.9) but had no docs/postmortem/ of its own while producing real escaped defects. Two postmortems written from this session's incidents; every guardrail entry names a mechanism that exists.

checks.pattern: two or more incidents converge|≥2 incidents converge

cases.desc: eng-init published an error-message protocol in gate-quality-contract.md and none of its five gates followed it (FAIL / ERROR: / ::error:: / three success shapes). One implementation in scripts/gate_output.py; conformance pinned in both directions.

A fix commit reported syncing a section whose str.replace anchor did not match, so nothing changed and nothing said so (postmortem 0002 instance 9). check_doc_claims.py compares each documented claim to the artifact it describes, derives both sides of every count rather than hard-coding one, and runs in selfcheck.

checks.pattern: derive both sides, never hard-code one

cases.desc: Three hand-maintained gate lists went stale the moment a gate was added (exit-2 conformance missed check_skill_content, the mutation inventory missed check_doc_claims, and check_doc_claims shipped with ten unproven branches). Deriving each list fixed each instance; these two assertions fix the property — a gate cannot enter the repository without entering the machinery that proves it rejects anything.

exemption_registry_hygiene names three accept/reject rules (stale target, empty reason, contradictory lists) but its Validator gave a rejection sample only for the first. The gate-quality-contract this skill publishes requires a paired sample per rule in the same change, so the criterion violated the contract it enforces on target repos. All three samples are now named in the recipe and mirrored in the registry validator.

incident_pipeline's validator was existence-only and asserted that 'lessons recurring across >=2 incidents are promoted' — a semantic judgement no deterministic gate can make, stated as though a check covered it (contract rule 5). The recipe now carries three rejection samples, and the promotion decision is declared a human call in all four places that state the rule, with only its mechanical half gated: a danger-patterns doc must link two or more distinct postmortems.

checks.pattern: human call, and no gate enforces it
